0022600214.text: The Utah Jazz (1-9, 1-4 at home) host the Miami Heat (4-6, on a one-game winning streak) in Utah's 11th game of the season, with the Jazz on an eight-game losing streak and 15th in the West. Utah is missing Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), Keyonte George (ankle sprain) and Lauri Markkanen (wrist sprain), while Miami has no players listed as unavailable. The teams have not met yet this season, and they split their 2025-26 series 1-1, with the Jazz winning the most recent meeting 115-111 in Miami on February 9, 2026.
